title: Bozo Net Casting
tagline: Open the net over the river.
description: The cast net of the great West African river: stand in a dugout canoe, read the shoals, choose a net and its weights, swing and let go when it opens wide. Dawn, noon, golden hour and dusk waters, low water to flood, a daily river, a logbook of the delta's fish, and Watch & Learn.
howToPlay: Tap one of the three nets, then Shallow, Middle or Deep for its weights.
Press the water where the net should land and keep your finger down: the net swings.
Let go when the circle is widest, in the green band of the gauge.
Lead the shoal and read the current: a slow net lets fish dart away.
Six casts make a session; use Think for a suggestion.
